name: Claims
description: The experience of making an insurance claim, from initial notification through to resolution. Currently mapped from discovery research; digital claim lodgement is not yet available online.

stages.name: Incident Occurs
stages.description: Something happens that may be covered by the member's insurance policy
actions: Experience the incident (storm, theft, accident, damage)
thoughts: Do I need to call the police?

painPoints.description: Members don't know what their policy covers without logging into My Account and reading the PDS. In a crisis moment, this information needs to be immediately accessible.
No guidance on immediate steps to take. Members don't know whether they need a police report, photos, or tradesperson quotes before contacting RAA.

opportunities.description: Add a 'What to do after an incident' guide accessible from My Account and the RAA app, tailored to the member's specific policy type
Push notification via the RAA app after major weather events in the member's area with a direct link to start a claim

stages.name: Lodge a Claim
stages.description: Member contacts RAA to lodge their claim. Currently phone-only with a 'Make a claim' link in My Account that also directs to phone.
actions: Provide policy details and incident information
thoughts: How long will this call take?

painPoints.description: No online claim lodgement. The 'Make a claim' button in My Account directs to a phone number. Members expect a digital form.
Phone wait times average 8-12 minutes during peak periods (after storms). Members already stressed by the incident face long holds.
Members have to re-explain their policy details over the phone despite being logged into My Account. No data is passed to the call agent.

opportunities.description: Build an online claim lodgement form accessible from My Account that collects incident details, photos, and supporting documents
Pass member and policy context to the call agent when a member calls from My Account so they don't have to re-identify

stages.name: Claim Progress & Resolution
stages.description: Member waits for their claim to be assessed, receives updates, and the claim is resolved
thoughts: Who do I contact for updates?

painPoints.description: No online claim tracking. Members cannot see the status of their claim in My Account. They must call for updates.
Communication is inconsistent. Some updates come by email, some by phone, some by letter. No single channel.
Average claim resolution time is not communicated upfront. Members have no expectation of timeline.

opportunities.description: Build a claim tracker in My Account showing the current status, next steps, and expected timeline
Consolidate all claim communications into a single thread in My Account with push notifications

insights.description: 7 of 8 participants in the February 2026 test expected to be able to lodge a claim online. All 7 were disappointed when the 'Make a claim' button led to a phone number.
Claims call volume spikes 400% in the 48 hours after major storm events. Average wait time during these peaks is 18 minutes.
6 of 6 claims interview participants said the lack of online tracking was their biggest frustration. All had called multiple times for status updates.
NPS for the claims journey is -12, compared to +45 for the quote to buy journey. Claims is the single biggest detractor of overall RAA member satisfaction.

changelog.description: Journey data published with full research findings, pain points, opportunities, and insights
